cases.excerpt: a firm strategy that keeps maximum pressure on the Iranian regime
cases.sourceContext: This morning on Fox & Friends, President Donald J. Trump delivered a clear, uncompromising update on U.S. operations against Iran. President Trump detailed total naval control of the Strait of Hormuz, unmatched U.S. intelligence and strike readiness, and a firm strategy that keeps maximum pressure on the Iranian regime while leaving the door open to a deal that serves American interests.

cases.excerpt: Most importantly, we have a deal that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon.
cases.sourceContext: “Most importantly, we have a deal that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon.” – President Trump 🇺🇸
